INPUT ROLES, in supplied order:

2. design_reference.png is ONLY the approved design, colour and material reference. Its three-quarter perspective, lighting and background must NOT transfer.
3. concept_crop.png is supporting original colour/design reference only.

GEOMETRY LOCK: Preserve the first image's exact outline, size, position, every shape edge, opening, existing bevel and visible detail. Keep the stem, domed shoulder, side protrusions, straight horizontal bands, two tall inset windows, central lower clasp, foot and base precisely where they are in the guide. Gold should read as clean polished gold through its base colour and fine wear, without painted lighting. Match the design's restrained chips and rivets as surface details, never change the silhouette or structural edges.

LIGHTING: FLAT ALBEDO TEXTURE SOURCE, not a beauty render. Uniform shadowless frontal illumination, equally bright at left and right and top and bottom. Remove the grey guide's baked lighting while retaining exact geometric boundaries. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no white glossy streaks, no rim light, no vignette, no floor, no background, no glow cast onto adjacent surfaces. Luminous parts are simply their bright local red or blue-white colours. No black edge gradients around the windows. No text or labels. Keep the guide's transparent pixels transparent. Return the finished native 1024 x 1024 RGBA image without resizing.
